cli.usage:
Kanso {{version}} — 100% local.

Usage: kanso <command>

  init       choose your invoices folder and have Kanso start with your Mac
  update     get the latest version and build it
  doctor     check that everything works
  uninstall  remove Kanso from the Mac (your folder and your data are kept)
  demo       open a demo with made-up data, without touching your folder
  serve      start the server (automatic launch does this for you)
  version    show the version
cli.noFolder: No folder chosen: run “kanso init” first.

init.hello: Kanso — 100% local: your invoices, your bank and your figures stay on your Mac.
init.ask: Where should your invoices go? A name (folder created in Documents) or a path
init.existing: Existing folder, nothing in it is moved: {{path}}
init.create: The folder {{path}} doesn't exist. Create it?
init.agent: Automatic launch installed: Kanso starts with your Mac.
init.access: If macOS asks for access to the folder, click “Allow”.
init.notReady: Kanso isn't responding yet: run “kanso doctor” in a minute.
init.next: In the app: allow notifications, then open Settings.

update.noRepo: This folder isn't a git clone of Kanso: {{path}}
update.done: Updated: Kanso restarts on its own and the page reloads.

uninstall.confirm: Remove Kanso from this Mac? Your folder {{path}} and your data are kept.
uninstall.done: Kanso is removed. Your folder is untouched: {{path}}
uninstall.repo: To finish, you can delete the code folder: {{path}}

doctor.folderMissing: Folder not found: {{path}} (moved? run “kanso init” again)
doctor.serverDown: Kanso isn't responding: check the log {{log}}
doctor.access: macOS lets Kanso read the folder
doctor.noAccess: macOS denies access to the folder: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Files and Folders
doctor.noApp: Mac app not installed: run “make app”

doctor.noNotifications: Notifications not allowed: System Settings › Notifications › Kanso
doctor.loginItem: The app opens when your Mac starts
doctor.noLoginItem: The app doesn't open when your Mac starts: Settings › Notifications, in the app
doctor.focus: Focus mode: add Kanso to the allowed apps to get reminders
doctor.noData: No data yet: open the app to get started
doctor.downloadsDenied: macOS refuses Kanso access to Downloads: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Files and Folders
